Rhoback is hiring an Associate Frontend Developer to build and refine the customer-facing experience on rhoback.com. The role focuses on developing React interfaces, supporting product launches and marketing campaigns, and maintaining the site’s UI/UX quality and performance.
Fashion
Lifestyle
Responsibilities
Build and maintain frontend components in React, with an eye toward reusability, accessibility, and clean markup
Partner with the Creative Marketing team to translate Figma designs into pixel-accurate frontend experiences using our CMS and Visual Editor
Own the UI/UX quality of the site end to end, from homepage and navigation through Product, Collection, and landing pages, including layout, imagery, and the details that make browsing feel effortless
Build landing pages for marketing campaigns and digital advertising
Build and own the process for new product drops: everything required on the website to go live with new product categories
Manage and optimize product data, metadata, and assets so they render correctly and read well across the site
Monitor site performance and drive optimizations for load times, mobile responsiveness, Core Web Vitals, and overall user experience
Implement customizations and feature enhancements as directed by the Senior E-Commerce Solutions Architect
Collaborate with Marketing and E-Commerce to troubleshoot issues, ship new features, and roll out seasonal aesthetic updates
Debug and resolve issues promptly; regularly test site features for bugs and performance problems
Participate in code reviews and maintain clear documentation of all development work
Provide technical support to the front-end and back-end teams to keep the site running smoothly

Required
1–2 years of frontend or e-commerce development experience
Strong skills in React, JavaScript, HTML, and modern CSS
Demonstrated eye for UI detail: spacing, typography, responsive behavior, and interaction states
Working knowledge of Shopify and its product data model
Basic proficiency with version control systems such as Git
Problem-solving mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve issues quickly
Eagerness to learn and stay current on frontend and e-commerce trends
Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment
No-task-too-small attitude and genuine team-player mentality
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Web Development, Design, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
Preferred
Experience using Figma for design-to-development handoff
Experience with a component-driven CSS approach such as Tailwind, CSS Modules, or styled-components
Experience with a Content Managemet System (CMS) or Visual Editor tool (Pack, Contentful, Sanity, or similar)
Familiarity with technical search engine optimization (SEO) and accessibility best practices
Exposure to headless commerce architectures
Portfolio, GitHub profile, or live site examples demonstrating frontend or e-commerce work strongly preferred
Benefits
Additional rewards may include performance bonuses, long-term incentives, an FTO policy.
